001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.EncoderProvider;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoderRegistry;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter;
008
009/**
010 * An abstract formatter where the actual full layout of the event is not a concern of the
011 * user and by default usually has the semi-standard layout of <strong>TTLL - Time,
012 * Thread, Level, Logger</strong>.
013 *
014 * It allows changing the format of time, thread, level, logger, etc. Typically the
015 * formatters get called in the following order.
016 * <ol>
017 * <li>Timestamp</li>
018 * <li>Thread</li>
019 * <li>Level</li>
020 * <li>Logger Name</li>
021 * <li>Key Values if enabled</li>
022 * <li>Formatted Message</li>
023 * <li>Throwable if not null</li>
024 * </ol>
025 * If plugins would like to provide some sort of standard formatter they should extend
026 * this class as well as the {@link AbstractBuilder}.
027 *
028 * @see AbstractBuilder
029 */
030public class AbstractStandardEventFormatter implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter {
031
032        /**
033         * immutable field
034         */
035        protected final LogFormatter timestampFormatter;
036
037        /**
038         * immutable field
039         */
040        protected final LogFormatter threadFormatter;
041
042        /**
043         * immutable field
044         */
045        protected final LogFormatter levelFormatter;
046
047        /**
048         * immutable field
049         */
050        protected final LogFormatter nameFormatter;
051
052        /**
053         * immutable field
054         */
055        protected final LogFormatter messageFormatter;
056
057        /**
058         * immutable field
059         */
060        protected final LogFormatter keyValuesFormatter;
061
062        /**
063         * immutable field
064         */
065        protected final LogFormatter throwableFormatter;
066
067        /**
068         * Combined formatter.
069         */
070        protected final LogFormatter eventFormatter;
071
072        /**
073         * Override
074         * @param timestampFormatter not <code>null</code>.
075         * @param threadFormatter not <code>null</code>.
076         * @param levelFormatter not <code>null</code>.
077         * @param nameFormatter not <code>null</code>.
078         * @param messageFormatter not <code>null</code>.
079         * @param throwableFormatter not <code>null</code>.
080         * @param keyValuesFormatter not <code>null</code>.
081         */
082        protected AbstractStandardEventFormatter( //
083                        LogFormatter timestampFormatter, //
084                        LogFormatter threadFormatter, //
085                        LogFormatter levelFormatter, //
086                        LogFormatter nameFormatter, //
087                        LogFormatter messageFormatter, //
088                        LogFormatter throwableFormatter, //
089                        LogFormatter keyValuesFormatter) {
090                super();
091                this.levelFormatter = levelFormatter;
092                this.threadFormatter = threadFormatter;
093                this.timestampFormatter = timestampFormatter;
094                this.nameFormatter = nameFormatter;
095                this.messageFormatter = messageFormatter;
096                this.throwableFormatter = throwableFormatter;
097                this.keyValuesFormatter = keyValuesFormatter;
098
099                this.eventFormatter = build( //
100                                timestampFormatter, //
101                                threadFormatter, //
102                                levelFormatter, //
103                                nameFormatter, //
104                                messageFormatter, //
105                                throwableFormatter, //
106                                keyValuesFormatter);
107
108        }
109
110        /**
111         * Creates the standard default TTLL layout. This is largely the default of Log4J2 and
112         * Logback if no formatting is picked. An example of what the default roughly looks
113         * like:
114         *
115         * <pre>
116         * 17:47:33.163 [main] WARN  com.my.MyLogger - Hello Warn Message {k1=v1}
117         * 17:47:33.167 [main] DEBUG com.my.MyLogger - Hello Debug Message {k1=v1}
118         *
119         * </pre>
120         * @param timestampFormatter not <code>null</code>.
121         * @param threadFormatter not <code>null</code>.
122         * @param levelFormatter not <code>null</code>.
123         * @param nameFormatter not <code>null</code>.
124         * @param messageFormatter not <code>null</code>.
125         * @param throwableFormatter not <code>null</code>.
126         * @param keyValuesFormatter not <code>null</code>.
127         * @return formatter.
128         */
129        public static LogFormatter build(LogFormatter timestampFormatter, //
130                        LogFormatter threadFormatter, //
131                        LogFormatter levelFormatter, //
132                        LogFormatter nameFormatter, //
133                        LogFormatter messageFormatter, //
134                        LogFormatter throwableFormatter, //
135                        LogFormatter keyValuesFormatter) {
136                var b = LogFormatter.builder();
137                if (!timestampFormatter.isNoop()) {
138                        b.add(timestampFormatter);
139                        b.text(" ");
140                }
141                if (!threadFormatter.isNoop()) {
142                        b.text("[");
143                        b.add(threadFormatter);
144                        b.text("] ");
145                }
146                if (!levelFormatter.isNoop()) {
147                        b.add(levelFormatter);
148                        b.text(" ");
149                }
150                b.add(nameFormatter);
151                if (!keyValuesFormatter.isNoop()) {
152                        b.add(BracedKeyValuesFormatter.ofStandard(keyValuesFormatter));
153                }
154                if (!messageFormatter.isNoop()) {
155                        b.text(" - ");
156                        b.add(messageFormatter);
157                }
158                b.newline();
159                if (!throwableFormatter.isNoop()) {
160                        b.add(throwableFormatter);
161                }
162                return b.build();
163        }
164
165        /**
166         * Abstract TTLL Builder.
167         *
168         * @param <T> builder type.
169         */
170        public static abstract class AbstractBuilder<T> {
171
172                /**
173                 * mutable field
174                 */
175                protected LogFormatter levelFormatter = LevelFormatter.ofRightPadded();
176
177                /**
178                 * mutable field
179                 */
180                protected LogFormatter timestampFormatter = TimestampFormatter.of();
181
182                /**
183                 * mutable field
184                 */
185                protected LogFormatter threadFormatter = LogFormatter.builder().threadName().build();
186
187                /**
188                 * mutable field
189                 */
190                protected LogFormatter nameFormatter = LogFormatter.builder().loggerName().build();
191
192                /**
193                 * mutable field
194                 */
195                protected LogFormatter messageFormatter = LogFormatter.builder().message().build();
196
197                /**
198                 * mutable field
199                 */
200                protected LogFormatter throwableFormatter = ThrowableFormatter.of();
201
202                /**
203                 * mutable field
204                 */
205                protected LogFormatter keyValuesFormatter = LogFormatter.noop();
206
207                /**
208                 * For builder
209                 * @return this.
210                 */
211                protected abstract T self();
212
213                /**
214                 * Do nothing constructor
215                 */
216                protected AbstractBuilder() {
217                }
218
219                /**
220                 * Sets timestamp formatter. If not set
221                 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.TimestampFormatter#of()} will be used.
222                 * @param timestampFormatter formatter to use for rendering
223                 * {@link LogEvent#timestamp()}.
224                 * @return this builder.
225                 */
226                public T timestampFormatter(LogFormatter timestampFormatter) {
227                        this.timestampFormatter = timestampFormatter;
228                        return self();
229
230                }
231
232                /**
233                 * Sets thread formatter. If not set thread name will be used.
234                 * @param threadFormatter formatter to use for rendering thread information.
235                 * @return this builder.
236                 */
237                public T threadFormatter(LogFormatter threadFormatter) {
238                        this.threadFormatter = threadFormatter;
239                        return self();
240                }
241
242                /**
243                 * Sets the level formatter. If not set
244                 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter#ofRightPadded()} will
245                 * be used.
246                 * @param levelFormatter formatter to use for rendering level information.
247                 * @return this builder.
248                 */
249                public T levelFormatter(LogFormatter levelFormatter) {
250                        this.levelFormatter = levelFormatter;
251                        return self();
252                }
253
254                /**
255                 * Sets the logger name formatter. If not set the default will be used.
256                 * @param nameFormatter formatter to use for rendering logger name.
257                 * @return this builder.
258                 */
259                public T nameFormatter(LogFormatter nameFormatter) {
260                        this.nameFormatter = nameFormatter;
261                        return self();
262
263                }
264
265                /**
266                 * Sets the throwable formatter. If not set
267                 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter#of()} will be used.
268                 * @param throwableFormatter formatter to use for rendering throwables.
269                 * @return this builder.
270                 */
271                public T throwableFormatter(LogFormatter throwableFormatter) {
272                        this.throwableFormatter = throwableFormatter;
273                        return self();
274
275                }
276
277                /**
278                 * Sets the throwable formatter. If not set
279                 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter#of()} will be used.
280                 * @param throwableFormatter formatter to use for rendering throwables.
281                 * @return this builder.
282                 */
283                public T throwableFormatter(ThrowableFormatter throwableFormatter) {
284                        this.throwableFormatter = throwableFormatter;
285                        return self();
286
287                }
288
289                /**
290                 * Sets the key values formatter. If not set the default key values formatter will
291                 * be used which is a noop.
292                 * @param keyValuesFormatter formatter to use for rendering key values.
293                 * @return this builder.
294                 */
295                public T keyValuesFormatter(LogFormatter keyValuesFormatter) {
296                        this.keyValuesFormatter = keyValuesFormatter;
297                        return self();
298                }
299
300        }
301
302        /**
303         * Convenience to register the encoder.
304         * @return encoder provider.
305         * @see TTLL#SCHEMA
306         */
307        public EncoderProvider toEncoderProvider() {
308                return EncoderProvider.of(LogEncoder.of(eventFormatter));
309        }
310
311        /**
312         * Will register this TTLL like encoder with the uri schema {@value TTLL#SCHEMA} and
313         * will be used as the default encoder if other encoders are not found.
314         * @param registry encoder registry.
315         */
316        public void register(LogEncoderRegistry registry) {
317                register(registry, TTLL.SCHEMA);
318        }
319
320        /**
321         * Registers this TTLL like encoder with the given uri schema.
322         * @param registry encoder registry.
323         * @param schema uri schema to register under.
324         */
325        public void register(LogEncoderRegistry registry, String schema) {
326                registry.register(schema, toEncoderProvider());
327        }
328
329        @Override
330        public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent logEvent) {
331                eventFormatter.format(output, logEvent);
332        }
333
334}
